reason: Daycare just went up and $59 a month is a real grocery bill for us. I'd rather do free library story time and church meetups with my group than pay for a cafe.
objection: Sounds expensive and a bit Instagram for Salisbury. I can't justify a monthly membership on $35k when most of what my kids need is a free room and other kids.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap or free trial visit, plus a drop-in around $5 a kid or a group rate for my moms group.
